Market today: The mood is cautiously optimistic with geopolitical de-escalation (Hormuz deal, lower oil) but also shifting tech alliances (HP/Huawei). This creates a mixed bag for your concentrated tech/chip book, as new partnerships could open doors but also introduce new competitive dynamics.

Your holdings: SOXL (-54.55%) and SPAL (-41.75%) are screaming for attention. Both are leveraged ETFs with massive drawdowns, and margin amplifies these drops. CRWD (+3.06%), SMH (-12.66%), and QQQI (-4.06%) are also flagged for trimming.

Watch: Keep an eye on how US-China tech partnerships evolve, especially after the HP/Huawei news. Also, monitor any shifts in US-South Korea economic ties, given South Korea's role in the chip supply chain.

Bottom line: Your leveraged positions are the immediate priority; manage risk there before considering new opportunities.
plays: SOXL: Review your stop at 200.00; a -54.55% loss on a leveraged product on margin is a major risk. Consider trimming to reduce exposure.
SPAL: Your new leveraged position is down -41.75%. Re-evaluate its stop at 21.38 and consider trimming to manage risk.
CRWD, SMH, QQQI: All are flagged for TRIM. Consider reducing positions to free up capital and reduce overall exposure.
